It is coercively positive exactly when kappa>L[Q0 inverse L]; equality has a null mode and a lower value has exactly one negative form direction. Under smooth compact-domain positive kinetic assumptions this gives the corresponding longitudinal squared-frequency sign. The dynamical theta transform preserves total energy, kinetic rank, one additional global canonical pair, and the linked trace zeta endpoints=ell.
